name: GCB
recent: Guan Chong Berhad 在2026年11月18日公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，并宣布第四次中期股息每股2.0仙。公司近期也持续出现大股东 Guan Chong Resources 的股权变动申报，以及凭单C转换带来的新股上市。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，并宣布第四次中期股息每股2.0仙。
凭单C转换后新股分别于2026年9月7日及9月21日上市。
大股东 Guan Chong Resources Sdn. Bhd. 在2026年9月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 董事在封闭期内表明有意进行证券交易。
凭单C持续转换导致已发行股本逐步增加。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为18.04亿令吉，环比下降31.2%，同比下降53.6%；净利为2.53亿令吉，环比增长104.8%，同比增长424.9%；净利率为14.0%，高于上一季度的4.7%。

recent_en: Guan Chong Berhad announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 and declared a fourth interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share on 18 November 2026. The company also saw continued substantial shareholder changes by Guan Chong Resources and new share listings from Warrant C conversions.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 and declared a fourth interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share.
New shares from Warrant C conversions were listed on 7 September 2026 and 21 September 2026.
Substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources Sdn. Bhd. filed multiple changes in interest between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Directors indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
Ongoing Warrant C conversions gradually increase the issued share capital.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,803.7 million, down 31.2% QoQ and 53.6% YoY; net income was RM253.0 million, up 104.8% QoQ and 424.9% YoY; net margin was 14.0%, up from 4.7% in the previous quarter.
